messages:
Priya (Customer Success): Greenlight from legal + infra for Acero private VPC. Quick checklist + asks before we hand to onboarding ops:
- confirm egress CIDRs for object storage + telemetry
- KMS key ARNs + rotation owner
- IAM roles & service accounts for model-serving nodes
- audit log sink destination & retention
- test plan for smoke (tokenized inference + perf)
ETA for cutover: Wed 2024-06-12. Note: renewal risk if cutover slips >30d, finance flagged potential bump. Tagging stakeholders.

Noah (Network Engineer): Thanks. For egress to S3/telemetry can you confirm they want public S3 or VPC endpoint? Also need NAT GW vs egress proxy decision.

Eve (Security Engineer): Need KMS policy template from customer for cross-account decrypt. Also require SIEM ingestion endpoint for audit logs. @Priya can you share contact?

Tom (Infra Engineer): For IAM, we prefer role-per-cluster model. We'll need the AWS account id + list of principals. Also what instance types for model-serving? affects SG and limits.

Priya (Customer Success): Contact is maya@acero.com. They prefer VPC endpoints if possible. Their AWS acct id: 123456789012. Will ask on NAT GW decision — they defaulted to proxy but open to endpoints.

Noah (Network Engineer): SG rule for internal model traffic: allow 10.1.0.0/16 TCP 2200-4000 (gRPC) from their subnets. For egress to telemetry (Splunk) they asked to allow outbound 443 to telemetry.redwood-prod.net. Quick snippet below:
```bash
# example security group egress
proto: tcp
dst: telemetry.redwood-prod.net:443
src: 10.1.0.0/16
```

Eve (Security Engineer): Auditing retention: compliance needs 365d min. Also require KMS key rotation schedule <= 90 days for high sensitivity. If they can't rotate we'll need a managed key.

Akshat (SRE): For cutover smoke, we'll run: 1) deploy canary model, 2) run 100 reqs/min for 5 min, 3) validate tokens and latencies. Can we get a test prompt set? Also set throttles to avoid blast.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll request test prompts today. On renewal risk: finance flagged that if go-live slips past 2024-07-15 renewal bump possible. Let's minimize delay.

Tom (Infra Engineer): Also need permission to create CloudWatch log group in their account or provide cross-account role for pushing logs. Which do they prefer?

Priya (Customer Success): They prefer cross-account role. I'll get ARN.

Eve (Security Engineer): Also need to confirm HSM/KMS provider: AWS KMS or external HSM? If external, we'll need network peering and cert exchange.

Noah (Network Engineer): One more — routing table entries for model subnets should include route to NAT/egress proxy. Sharing proposed route table id names in next message.

TelemetryBot: New log sink endpoint validated: s3://acero-redwood-audit-logs (write-only). Retention lifecycle = 400 days.

Priya (Customer Success): Great — action items: Priya -> get test set + KMS policy + cross-account ARN; Noah -> prepare SG & routes; Eve -> share KMS policy template; Tom -> cross-account role template + perf instance suggestions; Akshat -> smoke runbook draft. Please ack.

Noah (Network Engineer): Acked. I'll drop a terraform snippet in #eng-infra later.

Eve (Security Engineer): Ack.

Tom (Infra Engineer): Ack. Will prepare runbook.

Priya (Customer Success): Thanks all. I'll follow up with Maya and update this thread. :thumbsup:
